summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions, Inc. furnished a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 24, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing a hardware price increase across its subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices' security solution lineup. No special-situation transaction is present: the filing cites rising materials, electronic components, freight, manufacturing, regulatory compliance and compute costs, not any acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, spin-off, capital return or management change. CEO/CTO Steve Reinharz is quoted. No percentages, per-share prices, premiums, advisors, board recommendations or closing dates are stated. Watch for margin and demand effects on OTC-listed AITX, not deal arbitrage.
